free_tier.stated: no free tier; the smallest card on the store is CNY 1.00 a month and the cheapest one in stock is CNY 1.50 a month

retention.stated: the container persists while the monthly cycle is paid; the store states no deletion clock and no refund ('nat服务器不保证国内直连不支持退款')

egress.terms: 1000 GB a month at a 2000 Mbit/s shared port, no overage price published

interface_detail: root over SSH on one of the 20 forwarded ports of the shared IPv4, or over the dedicated IPv6
tooling: any SSH client; the port map is assigned in the vendor's control panel
chaining: the cheapest monthly-billed machine found at USD 0.22, so the machine a WireGuard node or a health monitor can sit on without a twelve-month commitment

limits.value: 2000 Mbit/s shared port; 20 NAT ports on a shared IPv4

binding_note: 1 TB a month is the ceiling a tunnel or a poller reaches first; 128 MiB of RAM and 2 GB of disk bind anything heavier than WireGuard long before the traffic does.

identity_cost.detail: an account on the vendor's client area is required to order; no card hold is stated anywhere on the store, and the payment rails appear only at checkout, so whether a card, Alipay or crypto is needed is unverified. The store shows no minimum top-up.

reliability_note: a two-person Chinese LXC shop; the page warns that NAT machines are not guaranteed to be directly reachable from mainland China and that there are no refunds, and stock is counted in single units
confidence_note: price, currency, monthly billing label, shape and stock read from the vendor's own WHMCS store; the CNY conversion uses the Central Bank of Russia table for 2026-10-24 cross-checked against the ECB rate for 2026-10-23

notes: This is the record behind the refutation of 'no monthly-billed machine under USD 1.00 exists'. Three cards are under USD 1.00 and in stock today: DE-2 at USD 0.2245 (2 units), US-1 at USD 0.2994 (10 units), and ITA-1 at USD 0.4491 (28 units); HK-2 and HK-3 at USD 0.1497 exist and are sold out. The billing period is the store's own monthly cycle, not an annual price divided by twelve. What is not established: the payment rails and any minimum top-up, whether the 20 NAT ports carry UDP, whether the shared IPv4 survives a node rebuild, and the renewal price (the store prints one price and no strike-through, so no promo is stated). The store's CNY prices are the vendor's own; no USD price is printed anywhere on it. | 2026-10-24: re-read for the UDP question and it is still not answered - the plan block names '20个nat端口' and no protocol. No company is named on the store and no registration number appears, so the counterparty is a two-person shop.

extras.price_arithmetic: CNY 1.50 a month billed monthly, converted at the CBR table for 2026-10-24 (80.5381 RUB per USD, 12.0557 RUB per CNY, so 6.6805 CNY per USD) = USD 0.2245 a month. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same. Cross-checked against the ECB rate for 2026-10-23 (6.6702 CNY per USD), which gives USD 0.2249.

network_out.ports: 20 forwarded ports on a shared IPv4, plus one dedicated IPv6

extras.renewal_note: the store prints one price per card with no strike-through and no end date, so no promotional rate is stated and the renewal is assumed equal to the first term; not confirmed at checkout
